text:
Brian Burke builds software and runs it. Before Creosote Labs he was chief operating officer of a venture-backed Silicon Valley startup, where he ran the company's operations and worked with its investors. Before that he taught adults for a decade as a yoga teacher, a personal trainer and a golf coach. He is a licensed real-estate agent, owns and renovates rental property, and has a philosophy degree from the University of San Francisco.

Creosote Labs started in 2026. Its work so far is on the [projects page](projects.html): a trip-operations system for a river outfitter, a practice website that sells courses, two products in development, five teaching applications and a set of tools. Most of it was built in 2026 with AI coding tools, by one person, and runs in production.

Creosote also trains teams to build this way: one day, on their own work.
